title: Claim Map
description: Structured proof-audit map (design/15 §4): per statement — proof granularity, dependency edges (which statements/assumptions it leans on), reverse edges (what depends on it), and novelty links back to P1 literature.

label.description: Short human name for UI graph nodes (e.g. 'Flow equivalence').

latex.description: Display-math LaTeX for the claim's core statement (UI hover, paper reuse).

depends_on.description: statement.* / assumption.* ids this claim leans on.

novelty_refs.description: lit.* ids from P1 this claim extends or contrasts.
